#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed Team Fortress 2 server — generated by provision().
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
for a in 32 64; do
    d="$HOME/.steam/sdk$a"
    [ -e "$d/steamclient.so" ] && continue
    for c in "$HOME/.local/share/Steam/steamcmd/linux$a/steamclient.so" \
             "$HOME/.steam/steamcmd/linux$a/steamclient.so" \
             "$HOME/.local/share/realmcradle/steamcmd/linux$a/steamclient.so"; do
        if [ -f "$c" ]; then mkdir -p "$d" && ln -sf "$c" "$d/steamclient.so"; break; fi
    done
done
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=".:bin:bin/linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/tf2/" || exit 1
exec ./srcds_linux64 -game tf -console -ip 0.0.0.0 -port 27100 +maxplayers 24 +map cp_dustbowl +hostname "\"Test World\"" \
    +sv_password "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" +rcon_password "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
